# Quickstart template

Read the [human–AI team workflow](HUMAN_AI_TEAM_WORKFLOW.md) and record actual human role and approval owners. It is coordination context for manual teamwork or optional orchestration; existing technical controls govern implementation and release.

Generated projects receive a tailored version of this file with their selected modules and commands. For a manually adopted project, fill the exact package manager/runtime, install command, start command, URL/port, sample input and expected output.

Local checks should not require provider credentials. List optional live names separately, with their module README. Record setup elapsed time only if measured. Include the first likely failure and a direct fix. Example: run npm ci, npm run dev, normalize the provided text, then npm run check. For Python add the specific uv sync/start steps only if selected.
